metadata.description: Marketplace for cc-multi-cli-plugin — delegation to Codex, Antigravity, and OpenCode CLIs from Claude Code.

plugins.name: multi
plugins.description: Hub — companion runtime, subagents, setup wizard, customization skills. Install first.

plugins.name: antigravity
plugins.description: Adds /antigravity:research and /antigravity:explore (read-only; Gemini 3.5 Flash via Google's headless agy CLI). EXPERIMENTAL. Requires multi and the agy CLI installed + signed in.

plugins.name: cline
plugins.description: Adds /cline:review (read-only second-opinion code review; GLM-5.2 via the Cline CLI). Requires multi.
